customize.text:
Ancient Sacred Mountain
<color=#ffffff>Quest Description:</color> <color=#ffffff>Find and stabilize the Astral Assemblage(s) to activate the Celestial Axis at the center of the Sacred City...</color>
Quest Objective: Try to activate the Astral Assemblage(s)
<color=#ffffff>Little One:</color> Rawr!
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Uh, this whole area is covered in liquid Phlogiston... Look at that giant fireball. Is that the "Astral Assemblage" we're supposed to be looking for?
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> But that fireball doesn't look like it's been sealed... Let's go take a look!
Quest Objective: Charge the Astral Assemblage(s)
<color=#ffffff>Convolution operation corrupted. Insufficient energy to support data...</color>
<color=#ffffff>Energy medium(s) near the activation site marked...</color>
<color=#ffffff>Little One:</color> Rrrah... Rawrgh!
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> You're patting your tummy... Are you hungry? Oh! You mean the fireball's hungry, is that it?
<color=#ffffff>Little One:</color> Rawr!
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Then let's fill its tummy up! But, uhh... what do fireballs even eat?
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Ah, Paimon didn't realize they even had that ability...
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> We've heard that Spiritways were created by the ancient dragons, but still...
<color=#ffffff>Oh, Chosen of Dragons... Submerge yourself in the pool of flowing flames, perceive... and then release its power.</color>
<color=#ffffff>With this, the "Astral Assemblage" can be released once more.</color>
<color=#ffffff>As you immerse yourself in the liquid Phlogiston, images flash through your mind like warm memories.</color>
<color=#ffffff>It is a memory from long ago. The great sovereign who once illuminated the world with his long horns changes the landscape within this mountain with but a flap of his wings.</color>
<color=#ffffff>Light and heat serve as messengers and heralds, conveying orders to flames in many-formed flow.</color>
<color=#ffffff>Then, the great king establishes here a repository for all memories and wisdom.</color>
<color=#ffffff>Thus is the Sacred City of Tollan created. Thus did it don its original form.</color>
<color=#ffffff>This is the first memory preserved in the lake of blazing fire.</color>
Quest Objective: Charge the Astral Assemblage(s)
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Paimon never knew the dragons used to have it so easy!
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Just jump in some liquid Phlogiston and let all that knowledge go glub-glub-glub into your mind...
<color=#ffffff>Little One:</color> Rawr!
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Oh! Did you see that too?
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Also, it looks like the power in the pool has returned to that big fireball...
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Ah! Watch out for the monsters!
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> It doesn't matter how many times Paimon sees it, it still seems super strange...
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> How on earth did they build the Spiritways...
<color=#ffffff>Little One:</color> Rawr!
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Hey! Are the Abyssal monsters trying to convert that thing? We can't let them have their way!
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Phew... Whatever that fireball's trying to swallow is really far away this time...
(If the player goes in the lava without indwelling a K <color=#ffffff73>oholasaurus)</color>
<color=#ffffff>Indwell a Koholasaurus, and dive into the flaming pool</color>
<color=#ffffff73>(When interacting with the phlogiston pool)</color>
<color=#ffffff>Immerse</color>
<color=#ffffff>As you immerse yourself in the liquid Phlogiston, images flash through your mind like warm memories.</color>
<color=#ffffff>Many dragons once immersed themselves in the lake of flame, and thus did the information and wisdom carried within the liquid Phlogiston flow into their minds.</color>
<color=#ffffff>But that was in ages past. None now come to this place to seek wisdom.</color>
<color=#ffffff>Instead, these crystallizations of sagacity came to be used as proofs of strength... To think that such objects that might push an entire species into the next generation would be used as naught but weapons!</color>
<color=#ffffff>When the flame-lord of the many dragons feigned death on account of the pitch-black shadow that plagued him, when the human populace outside the volcano raised their banners of resistance...</color>
<color=#ffffff>Perhaps only violence could have suppressed the unease that people felt in their hearts.</color>
Quest Objective: Charge the Astral Assemblage(s)
<color=#ffffff>Energy medium retrieved.</color>
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Judging by the light next to the fireball, it looks like we need one more power source...
<color=#ffffff>Little One:</color> Rawr!
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Alright, let's keep moving forward!
Quest Objective: Charge the Astral Assemblage(s)
Quest Objective: Let the liquid Phlogiston flood the dry pond
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Huh, you mean here? But there's no lava here...
<color=#ffffff>Little One:</color> Rawr!
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Okay, now we can activate the... power? Whatever it is that's inside...
Quest Objective: Take a dip in the pond
<color=#ffffff73>(When interacting with the phlogiston pool)</color>
<color=#ffffff>Immerse</color>
<color=#ffffff>As you immerse yourself in the liquid Phlogiston, images flash through your mind like warm memories.</color>
<color=#ffffff>It has been many years since the Pyro Dragon Sovereign and the first human god tumbled together into the volcano's depths.</color>
<color=#ffffff>The Sacred City is pitch-dark, having been sealed. Whether through the loss of the primal flame or to adapt to realms now ruled by humanity, the ancient dragons have forsaken both wisdom and form. Others were reduced to ash when the furnace blazing in their breasts burned out.</color>
<color=#ffffff>The silver-white shadow steps alone into the turbulent blazing pool that lies within the ever-more-solitary city.</color>
<color=#ffffff>He knows he can no longer obtain new wisdom from it.</color>
<color=#ffffff>But why, he asks himself.</color>
<color=#ffffff>"Perhaps it is because memory, too, is a hard-to-come-by experience."</color>
<color=#ffffff>So he replies in self-mockery, for there are many figures he can now only meet here.</color>
Quest Objective: Try to activate the Astral Assemblage(s)
<color=#ffffff>Energy medium retrieved. Re-establishing corrupted signal flow.</color>
<color=#ffffff>Astral Assemblage resuming normal operations.</color>
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Okay, that hungry fireball should be full now!
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Wahh! Why are all those monsters here again...
<color=#ffffff>Little One:</color> Rawr!
Quest Objective: Use the Iridescent Beam to clear out the Abyss
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> The fireball... it's been sealed off...
<color=#ffffff>Oh, Chosen of Dragons... You have been baptized by the authority of flowing flame.</color>
<color=#ffffff>Oh, Chosen of Dragons... Activate the Iridescent Beam and vanquish the great foe of the Abyss...</color>
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Oh! The power of Phlogiston's flowing through it... But, uh, what should we do?
<color=#ffffff>Little One:</color> Rawr!
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Hmm, what's that? The Phlogiston mechanism? You wanna use that to fight back?
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Seems like that worked... Let's keep searching for more mechanisms!
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Yay, we got one of 'em!
Quest Objective: Re-activate the Astral Assemblage(s)
<color=#ffffff>Abyssal reactions, none... Recalculating.</color>
<color=#ffffff>If necessary, please restart the "Astral Assemblage" to restore stability.</color>
<color=#ffffff>Little One:</color> Rroo...
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Phew... Looks like it's finally over. Paimon's exhausted!
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> So, do we need to, what was it... re-activate that giant fireball?
<color=#ffffff>Beside the flaming pool, the silver-white and ash-covered shadows converse as such...</color>
<color=#ffffff>"...Phase Two experimental verification is complete. I name the thing that shall purify all and evolve all 'Huitzilopochtli,' or the 'Sweeping Skyfire'..."</color>
<color=#ffffff>"Not that this matters. Names shall lose meaning in this place very soon, after all."</color>
<color=#ffffff>Cold Voice:</color> "The Astral Assemblages must be activated and actively attached to serve as countermeasures against corruption. Before they are completely warped by the Abyss, they will self-destruct and eliminate its influence..."
<color=#ffffff>Cold Voice:</color> But how will you accurately identify targets as having been corrupted? A controllable specimen...
<color=#ffffff>Cold Voice:</color> Self-experimentation? Has sanity deserted you?
<color=#ffffff>"Hah. This too, is well. If nothing else, this decrepit body may still serve in this manner."</color>
<color=#ffffff>Cold Voice:</color> So, you shall be the least likely to survive once this system is activated, then?
<color=#ffffff>Cold Voice:</color> Has the Abyss at last rotted your mind? Or... do you simply wish for all your kin to be martyred upon your funeral pyre?
<color=#ffffff>"Such little faith you have in your people! All the lords have consented to this, save you."</color>
<color=#ffffff>Cold Voice:</color> They merely follow your plan as though blind, never once considering the true meaning behind the scheme... This action does not have my consent.
<color=#ffffff>"...That matters little. Destruction... shall also be rebirth. I have made my mind up as such."</color>
<color=#ffffff>"Hah... I fear this is as much time as I can spend awake each day. In any case, I shall activate it once all is prepared."</color>
<color=#ffffff>Cold Voice:</color> Is there no room for a different course? I am still searching for another way... Are you certain that you are not bathing the world in flame over some personal grudge?
<color=#ffffff>"Perhaps! I will do anything it takes to keep our shadow-foe beyond the circles of this world."</color>
<color=#ffffff>"Hah. Besides, 'another way,' you say... Will you really find what you seek from those 'humans' of yours? You are in too deep already. I see it..."</color>
<color=#ffffff>"I once tried to make you understand... But just as it was with those of our line who sought wisdom through the pools of flame, knowledge and acceptance are two different things."</color>
<color=#ffffff>Cold Voice:</color> ...
<color=#ffffff>"If you believe that I simply wish for 'destruction,' whereas you have a world you wish to construct... Then stop me. Slay me. Prove yourself to me!"</color>
<color=#ffffff>"But know this, Kukulkan, though it be not prophecy — simply advice from one who once walked this path. A day shall come..."</color>
<color=#ffffff>"...When you shall tread the same road as I."</color>
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Whoa... Another weird conversation...
<color=#ffffff>Paimon:</color> Who did those voices belong to...
